method_references.adaptation: single fixed band;24or48target-only labels; common future test blocks5–10

wearable: CCA/FBCCA/power are target-recording references and do not learn from source participants.
Physical amplitude unit undocumented; scale-dependent foundation-model runs held.
Uniform positive conversion applied to the complete training/test dataset is a different question from cross-sensor gain shift.

In wearable-calibration, budget0 uses source-only spectral ridge and budgets12/24/48 use target-only spectral ridge: do not join these as a continuous model-update curve. In wearable-etrca-calibration, budget0 is a separate analytic CCA reference and budgets24/48 are target-only ensemble TRCA.
Ensemble TRCA uses the same fixed6–80Hz input band, not the original three-filter-bank experiment. Its low scores do not establish the optimized method ceiling.
mobile_ssvep: 23 participants,3classes;8selected posterior scalp channels from32recorded or14ear channels, kept separate.
Five-second and two-second protocols must not share a ranking.
Five-second ear slow-walking CCA differs from paper by1.37percentage points; internal replay passed, exact author reproduction not established.
Scalp/ear amplitudes checked against original headers; mislabeled IMU/EOG channels excluded.
mobile_erp: Within-participant session transfer differs from participant-disjoint SSVEP.
Running uses17participants; standing/walking24. Compare paired common-cohort contrast separately.
One participant has100Hz conversion vs500Hz forothers.
attribution: Fixed-readout primary and train-only selected-readout sensitivity must both be visible; do not choose the better test score.
Participant bootstrap is descriptive and conditional, not independent retraining uncertainty or multiplicity-adjusted inference.
Constructor-random mean comes from3initializations, not3independent cohorts.
